subject: [PATCH v6 06/12] mm, swap: write back vswap zswap entries to physical swap

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds support for writing back zswap-backed vswap entries to physical swap. It mirrors the existing zswap writeback path, but allocates the backing physical slot on demand at writeback time instead of pre-allocating it. The zswap shrinker now skips vswap entries when out of physical swap space. This change allows vswap entries to be written back to physical swap, which was previously not possible.
